patch.value: Use authorized remote backends through a portable native adapter ABI
Core owns backend contracts; pm-web and MCP own transports. Rust interoperability only: no new backend or replacement pm-web client.

Synthetic remote adapters preserve refusal and receipt semantics; Unsupported capabilities fail before writes; ABI compatibility is checked; Typed SDK and bounded TOON/JSON CLI with actionable refusals, docs and example; Read-only public tracker copy validated without Git; npm and Bun release gates pass

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check: searched existing tracker items for adapter ABI and portable; no duplicate. Inspected pinned SDK 2026.10.21, current 2026.10.24 public exports, core workspace/runtime contracts, pm-web PmRunResult/complete-list receipt handling, and core MCP adapters. Core owns command/backend semantics, authorization and mutation receipts; pm-web/MCP own network transports. Implement a versioned bounded JSON byte boundary for caller-supplied authorized native adapters. No backend, HTTP client, shared cache, persistent lease or outbox is introduced. Rust SDK changes follow this native repository; validation tooling remains erasable TypeScript.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented the versioned bounded JSON byte ABI, typed get/list/claim/release operations, pre-dispatch admission, unchanged backend envelopes, and explicit dispatched/unknown-outcome refusals with no retries. Added offline adapter-check CLI; it reports compatibility only, never execution. No shared tracker state is written by the boundary. The authoritative native release SDK follows tracker policy, so release capability requires strict owner enforcement; the synthetic remote adapter tests enforce this inside core locking. Tests inject competing claims and release-and-claim handoffs at every one of six adapter boundaries on one non-git tracker. Added readonly public-copy validation using the real complete-list SDK certificate and native children without Git or Node.

value.text: Raw-byte review fix: check_adapter_transcript and NativeAdapterClient now share check_adapter_reply on exact recorded reply_bytes. No response re-encoding occurs before size/UTF-8/JSON/schema/ABI/correlation admission. Decoded reply transcripts are refused; the validation harness records response.stdout directly. A separate bounded 16 MiB transcript envelope permits a full 1 MiB frame encoded as a decimal byte array. Differential test raw_frame_seeded_corpus_matches_live_client covers 768 frames with seed 0x05eed113, 240 accepted and 528 refused, including limit -1/0/+1, the 5094-byte padded reproduction, escapes, Unicode, invalid UTF-8, truncation, oversized nesting, trailing data, duplicate/unknown fields, recursion, ABI and correlation errors. Verdict and refusal code match for every offline/live pair; live dispatch uncertainty remains explicit. Revert proof: node scripts/native-adapter-revert.mts temporarily restores ONLY offline decode/re-encode behavior; the corpus fails an assertion at frame 2 (4097 bytes at a 4096-byte ceiling: offline accepted versus live FrameLimit). It restores exact source bytes in finally. All 6 behavioral proofs failed as required, then the restored ABI suite passed 11/11; native CLI unit checks passed 2/2. Full npm/Bun release gates will run in CI at unchanged thresholds.
